name: Sunflora
description: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: The user’s body is forced to grow all at once. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.description: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.

moves.name: Grass Whistle
moves.description: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the foe into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the foe. It steals some HP from the foe to heal the user on every turn.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.description: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling filthy sludge at the foe. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
